t: This is the Garden Museum, Britain's only museum of the art, history and design of gardens. It sits in the former church of St Mary-at-Lambeth, and it re-opened in 2017 after an eighteen-month redevelopment. The church's burials give it a deeper story. William Bligh, of the Bounty mutiny, is buried here. After the mutineers set him adrift, he and his loyal men sailed more than three thousand nautical miles to Timor. Also buried here are Elizabeth Boleyn, mother of Anne Boleyn, and Elizabeth Howard, Duchess of Norfolk, whose unhappy marriage to the third Duke became a public scandal.
